snippet.title: Sugar Shatter - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Sugar Shatter is out now! Get it  on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4275860/Sugar_Shatter/

Sugar Shatter is a brick breaker fighting game where you have to hit a candy ball to break more bricks than your opponent. See if you can master the abilities of each character while navigating the hazards that may show up on the field. Play through a series of tournaments in campaign mode, or challenge your friends to a match in local or online multiplayer!

Explore the stories of the various characters of Candyland as you unlock buffs and upgrades on the path of becoming a Sugar Shatter Legend! Help each character overcome their personal struggles, and uncover their motivations and relationships along the way!

#indiegame #fightinggames #gaming
